about_the_game:
With this DLC you can activate the virtual reality mode in 4Prot. Before purchasing this add-on remember that you will need a gaming computer with a dedicated video card (minimum Nvidia GeForce 1060 or similar).

You will be able to not only view the project but also use the VR controllers to build and edit your project. It works in multiplayer mode with other VR computers or with sessions on Windows and Mac.

This DLC enables VR mode on your computer only, the APk to run 4Prot directly on the Virtual Reality glasses is not available.

Compatible with MetaQuest 2 -3 - 3s, Lenovo Think Reality and the latest versions of HTC (Vive Focus Vision).

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Catalina
  • Processor: Intel i3 6300 @ 3.8GHz or AMD FX 8150 @ 3.6GHz with 4 hardware threads
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GeForce® GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon™ HD 7850 or equivalent DX11 compatible GPU with 2GB of memory
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
